context: Documentary discussion: Asuka and Ren on society's development.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: documentary discussion; vocabulary (発展/宗教/自ら/北朝鮮/われわれ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この地域は、どう発展したんですか?
lines.style: curious young man voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 人々が、自ら道を切り開きました。
lines.en: People carved out their own path.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 宗教も、発展に関わったんですか?
lines.en: Did religion play a part in the development?
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、宗教が人々を結びつけました。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 北朝鮮は、別の道を歩んだんですか?
lines.en: Did North Korea walk a different path?
lines.style: thoughtful young man voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 北朝鮮は、独自の発展をしました。
lines.en: North Korea developed in its own way.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: われわれは、そこから何を学べますか?
lines.en: What can we learn from that?
lines.style: engaged young man voice, soft warm reflective throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: われわれも、自ら考え続けるべきですね。
lines.en: We too should keep thinking for ourselves.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
